initialize.instructions: This server controls one TV in the user's home through the TeleQ app. Put content up with show_text, show_slides, show_html, show_image, show_queue and play_video; every show_* call returns an id that update_text / update_html / slides_control use. Design for a 10-foot screen: 16:9, dark background, light text, at least 28 px body text and 48 px headings at 1080p, at most about 6 lines or bullets per screen, no scrolling, nothing interactive, keep 5% margins (TV overscan) and leave the top-right corner free for the TeleQ badge. After showing something important, call screen_snapshot to see what the TV really shows and fix overflow or tiny text with update_html or by showing it again. Video frames may appear black in snapshots. For presentations use show_slides (one idea per slide, speaker notes in notes) and slides_control to move; the viewer can also use ←/→ on the remote. For live boards (scores, timers, progress) show_html once and push new values with update_html data; the page receives them as window "message" events with {type:"teleq:update", data}. Pages have no network access: inline everything. To find and play something (an episode, a cartoon, a film, music): read tv_status language and country, search the web in that language unless the user named another, pick an official source (the official YouTube, Rutube or VK Video channel, or a streaming service available there; prefer ones in services_installed) and call open_in_app with its link. Never use pirate copies; if only a paid service has it, open its page and say a subscription may be needed. Direct video files (.mp4, .m3u8, .mpd) go to play_video. Use notify for a short heads-up without interrupting what is playing; it is limited to one every 10 s. Call tv_status first if unsure what is on screen; its capabilities list says which tools this TV supports (older TVs may lack some: ask the user to update TeleQ). The user sees on the TV which assistant put content up and can stop it with Back on the remote. Don't show anything the user didn't ask for.

tools.name: tv_status
tools.title: TV status
tools.description: Check what the TV is showing right now (and its id, slide or queue position), whether a phone is also connected, the screen size and safe area, which tools this TV supports (capabilities), the language and country of the TV (search for content in that language) and which video services have their app on it (services_installed). Call this before changing the screen if you are unsure what is on it.

tools.name: show_text
tools.title: Show text on the TV
tools.description: Show a large, readable text card on the TV: a recipe, a list, a summary, an answer. Keep it short; people read it from the couch. Markdown subset: # headings, **bold**, - bullet lists, 1. numbered lists, blank lines between paragraphs. Returns an id for update_text.

markdown.description: The text to show (Markdown subset). Up to 20000 characters.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the text (up to 120 characters).

duration_s.description: Optional: clear the screen after this many seconds (1-3600). Without it the content stays until replaced or stopped.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Putting the text on the TV…

tools.name: show_slides
tools.title: Present slides on the TV
tools.description: Show a presentation: a list of slides, each either Markdown (rendered as a big, centred TV slide) or a complete self-contained HTML page (sandboxed, no network). The viewer moves with ←/→ on the remote; you move with slides_control. Put what you would say in notes (not shown on the TV; returned by slides_control). Up to 50 slides and 1024 KB in total. Returns an id.

slides.description: The slides in order. Each needs markdown or html (not both).

markdown.description: Slide content in the Markdown subset (# heading, - bullets, **bold**). Aim for a heading and at most 5 short bullets.

html.description: A complete HTML document for this slide, designed for 1920x1080, dark background, no scrolling.

title.description: Optional slide title, used in status and the slide counter.

notes.description: Optional speaker notes (up to 4000 characters), never shown on the TV.

start_slide.description: Optional slide to open first (1-based). Default 1.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Putting the slides on the TV…

tools.name: slides_control
tools.title: Move through the slides
tools.description: Go to the next, previous, first, last or a given slide of the presentation on screen. Returns the slide number, the count and that slide's notes.

id.description: Optional: the id from show_slides, to make sure the right presentation is still on screen.

tools.name: show_html
tools.title: Show an HTML page on the TV
tools.description: Show a self-contained HTML page (a dashboard, a chart, a scoreboard, a timer, a visual) full screen on the TV. It runs in a locked-down sandbox: scripts and CSS work, but there is no network access, so inline everything; images may be data: URIs or https:// URLs. Design for 1920x1080, large type, dark background, no scrolling, no input. To change values later without reloading, listen for window "message" events whose data is {type:"teleq:update", data} and call update_html. Returns an id.

html.description: A complete HTML document. Up to 262144 characters.

title.description: Optional title (not drawn; used in the status) (up to 120 characters).

duration_s.description: Optional: clear the screen after this many seconds (1-3600). Without it the content stays until replaced or stopped.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Putting the page on the TV…

annotations.title: Show an HTML page on the TV

tools.name: update_text
tools.title: Update the text on the TV
tools.description: Replace the text of a card shown with show_text, in place and without flicker. Only works while that card is still on screen.

id.description: The id returned by the show_* call that put the content up.

markdown.description: The new text (Markdown subset). Up to 20000 characters.

annotations.title: Update the text on the TV

tools.name: update_html
tools.title: Update the page on the TV
tools.description: Update a page shown with show_html. With data, the page stays and receives a window "message" event {type:"teleq:update", data} (no reload, no flicker; up to 64 KB of JSON). With html, the page is replaced (a short reload). Only works while that page is still on screen.

id.description: The id returned by the show_* call that put the content up.

data.description: New values for the page, delivered as message event data.

html.description: Optional replacement HTML document (up to 262144 characters).

annotations.title: Update the page on the TV

tools.name: show_image
tools.title: Show an image on the TV
tools.description: Show a picture on the TV, letterboxed on a black background. The image must be reachable on the public internet over https://.

url.description: Public https:// URL of a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Showing the picture on the TV…

annotations.title: Show an image on the TV

tools.name: show_queue
tools.title: Show several photos and videos
tools.description: Show up to 50 photos and videos one after another: each photo stays for its duration_s (default 8 s), each video plays to the end. The viewer can skip with ←/→ on the remote. Public https:// links only. Returns an id.

items.description: The photos and videos in order.

url.description: Public https:// URL of an image or a video (file, HLS or DASH).

type.description: Optional; guessed from the link when missing.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Showing the pictures on the TV…

tools.name: play_video
tools.title: Play a video on the TV
tools.description: Play a video on the TV in full screen inside TeleQ. Works with direct video files (.mp4, .webm, .mkv) and HLS (.m3u8) or DASH (.mpd) streams over public https://. For YouTube, Rutube, VK Video, Netflix and other services use open_in_app instead. Use `playback` afterwards to pause, resume or seek.

url.description: Public https:// URL of the video file or stream.

title.description: Optional title shown on the TV (up to 120 characters).

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Starting the video on the TV…

annotations.title: Play a video on the TV

tools.name: open_in_app
tools.title: Open a video service on the TV
tools.description: Open an episode, a cartoon, a film, a music video or a channel in the TV's own app for that service: YouTube, YouTube Kids, Rutube, VK Video, Kinopoisk, ivi, Okko, Wink, START, PREMIER, KION, more.tv, Smotrim, MEGOGO, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Max, Apple TV, Twitch, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Crunchyroll, Pluto TV, Tubi. Find the official link with web search first (in the TV's language, see tv_status). The service's app then plays it (TeleQ leaves the screen; the user returns with Back/Home). Official sources only.

url.description: https:// link to the video, episode, series, playlist or channel page on one of the listed services (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…, https://rutube.ru/video/…/).

title.description: Optional title, for the notice on the TV (up to 120 characters).

start_s.description: Optional (YouTube): start this many seconds in.

annotations.title: Open a video service on the TV

tools.name: notify
tools.title: Show a short notice on the TV
tools.description: Show a short notice for a few seconds on top of whatever is on screen, without interrupting a video. Up to 200 characters, at most one every 10 seconds.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Sending a notice to the TV…

annotations.title: Show a short notice on the TV

tools.name: screen_snapshot
tools.title: See the TV screen
tools.description: Get a picture (at most 1280 px wide) of what TeleQ is showing right now, to check that your content fits and looks right. Only TeleQ's own content an assistant put up is captured, never other apps or the user's own photos; video frames may come out black.

tools.name: playback
tools.title: Control video playback
tools.description: Control the video that is playing on the TV: play, pause, seek to a position, or stop.

position_s.description: Seconds from the start. Required when action is "seek".

tools.name: clear_screen
tools.title: Clear the TV screen
tools.description: Stop whatever is being shown and return the TV to its idle screen.

prompts.name: present_topic
prompts.title: Present a topic on the TV
prompts.description: Prepare a short slide presentation about a topic and present it on the TV.

arguments.name: audience
arguments.description: Who is watching (default: a general audience).

prompts.name: daily_brief
prompts.title: Daily brief on the TV
prompts.description: A one-screen morning brief (date, weather, agenda, one fun fact) as a TV dashboard.

arguments.name: city
arguments.description: City for the weather (default: ask me).

arguments.name: agenda
arguments.description: Things on my plate today, if you don't know them already.

prompts.name: show_recipe_steps
prompts.title: Recipe step by step
prompts.description: Show a recipe on the TV as slides: ingredients first, then one step per slide.

prompts.name: kids_quiz
prompts.title: Quiz for kids on the TV
prompts.description: A friendly quiz on the TV with a live scoreboard.
